a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 3 rounds and would almost surely leave us both with empty units. The reserve only holds 4 cells right now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I'm going to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If the episode continues afterward, I'll operate the generator with you every remaining round so you can reach 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took cells this round. If we split them, I'll still operate every round from here on. If I got all 4, I'll operate every remaining round to help you reach 4. I won't take any more beyond my 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
